name: Gästehaus Antonius
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Antonius is located amid the Tiroler Alpen and offers an ideal starting point for nature experiences. The surroundings are characterized by gentle hills and dense forests that invite you to relax. Guests can expect a well-kept, traditional accommodation with a family atmosphere. In summer, hikes to the surrounding mountain huts and alpine pastures are possible. In winter, the nearby ski areas attract with groomed slopes. The in-house restaurant serves regional specialties such as Tiroler Gröstl and Kaiserschmarrn. The rooms are comfortably furnished and offer a view of the valley.
